intro.text: A Lord Merchant of the past, with no head for business, whose losses left his office deeply in debt to the Diem.

items.text: Vey told Kenton that Hennin became Lord Merchant only because he inherited two fortunes. A Lord Mastrell of the time placed the Diem's tribute in a savings account with him, and Hennin threw the principal away on bad investments. His successor inherited the debt, which grew with interest until no Lord Merchant could repay it.
